Thomas Hastings: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Thomas Hastings (1784–1872) · Hymn writer and composer

1 hymn and 3 hymn tunes on NoteFusion credit Thomas Hastings. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

  • Come, Ye Disconsolate

    Come, ye disconsolate, wher'er ye languish;
